title: Tangents on circle
summary:
This JSXGraph demo shows the __polar of a point__ with respect to a circle. If point *p* lies outside circle *c*, the polar line is constructed with the two tangents from to the circle. The intersections of the tangents with the circle define two points which define the *polar line*. If is on the circle, the polar line is tangent to the circle through .
